0022600214.text: The Miami Heat (4-6, eighth in the East) play their 11th game of the season as the away team at the Utah Jazz (1-9, 15th in the West), who are on an eight-game losing streak. Miami enters on a one-game winning streak, with a 3-3 road record, and the teams have split their 2025-26 series 1-1, most recently when the Heat lost 115-111 in Miami on February 9, 2026. Heat star Giannis Antetokounmpo is day-to-day with a wrist sprain and is a game-time decision, while Utah is without Jaren Jackson Jr. (knee), Jusuf Nurkic (foot strain), and Keyonte George (ankle sprain) and has Lauri Markkanen listed as day-to-day with a wrist sprain and a game-time decision.
